description: Answers: what is the latest news about <topic, person, place or word>? Every word in `query` must appear in the headline, the feed summary or the topics; newest first. `query` is required (at least one word of 2+ letters); search one language edition at a time.

lang.description: Edition language code. Each edition carries only articles written natively in that language. Use zh for Simplified, tw for Traditional Chinese.

name: news_search
title: Latest news about a topic
